definitions.explanation: Money set aside regularly for a specific future purpose — building repairs, retirement, a child's education, etc. Common contexts include condominium reserve funds and monthly savings plans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{積立金|つみたてきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}っている→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay into a savings fund every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧{積立金|つみたてきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The condo's repair reserve fund was increased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{若|わか}いうち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{積立金|つみたてきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧だろう。
examples.english: It's a good idea to start a savings plan while still young, for your retirement years.

notes:
Compound of {積立|つみた}て (the verb ⟦{積|つ}み{立|た}てる→積み立てる：21136_tsumitateru⟧, to accumulate) + {金|きん} (money). Implies regular, planned contributions rather than ad-hoc saving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧{積立金|つみたてきん}: building-repair reserve fund (condos)
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧{積立金|つみたてきん}: retirement savings
- {積立金|つみたてきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay into a savings fund
- {積立金|つみたてきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{崩|くず}す: to draw down the reserve fund

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧: savings — general term, not tied to a specific purpose
- ⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧: bank deposit — money held in a bank account
- ⟦{基金|ききん}→基金：20400_kikin⟧: fund; foundation — large pooled money for an organizational purpose
